info.name: University Services Platform - Group 6 (Facilities & Reservations) - Final Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Final Postman API Collection for Group 6 services: facility-resource-service (Port 8081) and university-reservation-service (Port 8082). Covers complete Facility & Resource CRUD, Availability Rules Engine (USMG6-104), Cross-Service Contracts for Groups 7 & 8, and Tech Lead edge-case verifications (DEF-07: 405 Method Not Allowed, 404 Route Not Found).
